4424.text:
4424 ghaná ² 'compact, firm, dense' Suśr., 'densely filled, deep (of sound or colour)' MBh. 2. n. 'any compact
mass' ŚBr., m. 'cloud' MBh. [* han -³] 1. Pa. ghana - 'solid, dense', Pk. ghaṇa - 'dense, difficult';
Ash. gäˊni-aṅúr 'thumb'; Wg. ganala-štä 'heavy';
Tir. gana 'big, tall'; Shum. gō̃ 'big'; Woṭ. gan , f. gen 'big, thick'; Kal. urt. ghāna , rumb. ghōna 'big'; Bshk. gäṇ , f. gīṇ 'big, elder'; Tor. gan , f. gen 'big', Mai. ghō̃ ;
Sv. ghaṇyeṛo 'elder'; Phal. ghāṇu , f. ghēṇi 'big'; K. gonᵘ 'solid, dense, strong'; S. ghaṇo 'much, many', °ṇi f.
'multitude'; L. ghaṇā 'thick', khet. (LSI) ghannē 'many'; P. ghaṇā 'thick, dense', Ku. ghaṇo , N. ghanu ,
A. ghan (whence ghanāiba 'to thicken'), B. ghana (whence ghanā 'to come close to'); Bi. ghan 'sowing
thickly'; OMth. OAw. ghana 'dense', H. ghanā ; Marw. ghaṇo 'big'; OG. ghaṇauṁ 'much'; G. ghaṇũ 'dense,
close', M. ghaṇ , Si. gana . — Variant and poss. unconnected
forms in Dard.: * ghāna - in Paš. ar. goṓn 'heavy' and perh. in Shum. Kal. Mai. above; — * ghaṇḍa - (→ Par. ghaṇḍ 'big' IIFL i 253) in Paš. ar. gǟṛ , chil. gā̃ṛ , nir. gaṇ 'big', ar. gaṇ-ayōm 'my grandmother',
Shum. gãṛ-ayem and perh. in Bshk. Sv. Phal.
above; — * ghanta - in Tor. gand 'big', Gau. gōnt . 2. Pk. ghaṇa - m. 'cloud', Si. gana ; — K. gan m. 'log
of wood'; — P. ghaṇ m. 'bees'; — Kho. gɔˋn 'haft of
axe, spade or knife' (or < gaṇḍa -²). * ghanatara-; *saṁghana-, saghana-; — *ghāna -². Addenda: ghaná-²: S.kcch. ghaṇo 'sufficient', ghɔˋṇɔ 'dense,
compact, thick'; Garh. ghaṇu 'thick'; Md. gina 'much, many'.

9190.text:
9190 bahutva n. 'abundance' MBh. [Development as an adjective is attested by Ko. mhop < MIA. * bahuppa -.
But Pk. bahutta - was influenced as an adjective by pahutta - < prábhūta - (as bahūa - for bahua - by pahūa -). — bahú -] Pa. bahutta - n. 'abundance, multiplicity'; Pk. bahutta -, bahūa - 'much' (X pahutta -, pahūa - < prábhūta - ?); Gy. eur. bū̆t 'much, many'; Tor. but 'much', P. bahut , bauhat , bahutā , Ku. bhaut , N. A. B. bahut , Or. bahuta , bhauta , bout ; Mth. bahut , °to 'much,
many', OAw. bahuta , H. bahut , OMarw. bahuta , bahota , bhota , G. bahut , bɔt , M. bahū̆t , Ko. (LSI) mhop , mop ; — with - er - < - a-tara -: P. bauhterā , batherā 'abundant'; H. bahuter , °rā 'very many, most',
adv. 'for the greater part'. — Sh.pales. buṭe 'much,
many' AO xviii 228 (→ Ḍ. bū̆ṭ , Bur. buṭ ) is obscure and
connected rather with Mai. būṭ 'all', ky. buṭa , Sh.gil. bŭṭṷ . Addenda: bahutva-: WPah.poet. bɔ̈̄to 'much, (pl.) many', J. bohit 'much, abundant'; Garh. bhɔt 'much'.

345.text:
345 ánēka 'many' ŚBr. [ ēká -] Pa. anēka -, Pk. aṇēa -, aṇekka -, Si. nē , ne - in cmpds.
(or poss. < naika -). anēḍa- see anēnás -.

9188a.text:
9188a † bahutara- 'more, many' MBh. [ bahú -] Md. baivaru 'many'?; S.kcch. baurā pl. 'many',
WPah.kṭg. (kc.) bhɔˋri indecl. 'much, many, very',
jaun. bharī 'many', kiũth. bhaurī 'much' — or < bahura -.

250.text: 250 ádhika '*upper; additional' KātyŚr. [ ádhi ] Pa. adhika - 'superior'; Pk. adhiga - 'additional'; Pr. alʸi 'heaven, the upper world'. * adhikatara-, *aṣṭādhika -. Addenda: ádhika-: Kho. ahi rather than with BKhoT 65 < ádhi .
